description: Gracefully exit with a non-zero code and detailed message if the mandatory TOC markers are missing from the file.
spec:
1. Check for the presence of *both* '<!-- toc -->' and '<!-- /toc -->' markers.
2. If only one is present, or neither is present, halt processing immediately.
3. The error message must guide the user on how to fix the file structure (i.e., add both markers).
title: Robust error handling for missing TOC markers
